title: National Coffee Day 2026: free and cheap coffee deals today
dek: September 29 is National Coffee Day, and chains like Dunkin', Circle K and Whataburger are offering free or discounted coffee.
body: Good morning. Today, September 29, is National Coffee Day, and a lot of places are celebrating with deals. If coffee is part of your morning anyway, it is a nice day to let it cost a little less.

Here are a few I found. Dunkin' is offering a free medium hot or iced coffee with any purchase in its app. Whataburger has a free 16-ounce hot or iced coffee today when you order online or in the app. Circle K is giving rewards members a free medium hot or iced coffee, and 7-Eleven has a large coffee for $1.49 for rewards members. Krispy Kreme is offering a free small or medium coffee with a purchase.
Most of these need an app or a rewards account, and details can vary by location, so it is worth checking before you get in line.
I also like days like this as a reminder to thank the people who make our coffee every morning. They see us at our sleepiest and still manage to be kind about it.
If you pick up a free coffee today, put the money you saved toward a good tip for the person behind the counter.
